SELECT e.empno, e.ename, d.dname, (COALESCE(e.sal, 0) + COALESCE(e.comm, 0)) AS totalIncome, s.grade AS salaryGrade, (SELECT STRING_AGG(sub.ename, ', ') FROM emp sub WHERE sub.mgr = e.empno) AS subordinates, e.emergency_contacts AS emergencyContacts FROM emp e LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.deptno = d.deptno LEFT JOIN salgrade s ON (COALESCE(e.sal, 0) + COALESCE(e.comm, 0)) BETWEEN s.losal AND s.hisal
e.ename LIKE CONCAT('%', #{ename}, '%')
ORDER BY e.empno ASC
